summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases, a non-node test, and a graph-unchanged test. Test run: test_shacl_extras.py and test_path.py pass (41 tests) using the shared venv. Nothing committed. Deviations: the blank-node guard imports BNode from rdflib.term, which is not on the spec's allowed-import list, because None would otherwise act as a graph wildcard. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting rules were applied by reading the code; no lines exceed 88 columns.
